goal: The archive sweep archives a phase only when every DONE task's work is landed -- a Landed receipt on its latest run or an ancestry probe confirming its recorded work is reachable from the landing base -- otherwise leaving the phase active with the blocking task id reported, and a task whose landing state cannot be determined fails closed as a surfaced indeterminate-landing strand instead of counting as landed.

graders.run: bash -c 's=$(uv run pytest packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_archive_landed_predicate.py -q 2>&1); r=$?; echo "$s"; [ "$r" -eq 0 ] || exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -qi skipped && exit 1; echo "$s" | grep -q " passed"'

packages/flywheel-worktree/src/flywheel_worktree/worker.py -- archive_phases (~1228) is the worktree caller to keep threading; GitWorktreeSubmitter._is_ancestor (~928) shows the ancestry-probe primitive (git merge-base --is-ancestor); branch naming flywheel/<phase>/<task-id> lives in _branch (~375); module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/events.py -- Landed (~293, strategy + landed_ref) is the landing receipt; LandingParked (~255) marks the strand
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_tui.py -- the /archive action calls archive_completed_phases(archive_tasks_dir, store) (~452); third call site, update it in this change
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_workflow.py -- archive, loop-path-gate, loop-base, and status suites: keep green, assertions unmodified
packages/flywheel-worktree/tests/test_worker.py -- the -k archive tests: keep green, assertions unmodified
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/tests/test_archive_landed_predicate.py -- new test file this task must add; the behavior grader runs exactly this path
constraints: D-1: a DONE task counts landed when a Landed domain event exists on its latest run (fast path) OR the ancestry probe confirms its recorded work is an ancestor of the landing base at sweep time (git merge-base --is-ancestor); hand-landed receipt-less work must archive via ancestry alone

D-4: no receipt and no resolvable branch/recorded head fails closed -- the phase stays active and the sweep records a stop event with the stable kind token "indeterminate-landing" keyed to the task id so flywheel status surfaces it; cannot-check never counts as landed
A blocked phase's refusal names the blocking task id through the existing log callable, the same seam the loop-path and phase-verify refusals use
Must not regress: a phase with any non-DONE task stays active; the loop-path archive gate; the phase_verify exit gate; .loop-base materialization on archive; the dest.exists() no-clobber guard

Layering: flywheel-orchestrator must not import flywheel_worktree -- run the probe via a git subprocess against the already-threaded repo_root (the module already shells out for phase_verify and phase-diff) or accept a probe callable threaded from callers

Update every archive_completed_phases call site in this same change: worker.archive_phases (worktree ~1262), _cmd_archive (_workflow.py ~1763, thread repo_root so the CLI verb can probe), and the TUI /archive action (_tui.py ~452)
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not change stop-event resolution stamping or add attribution -- that is strand-resolution-attribution's slice
Do not recover, rebase, or land stranded branches (spec 00076 owns recovery)
Do not modify or weaken assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: A probe that always answers landed must fail: the criterion-1 harness has a divergent-base strand whose head is NOT an ancestor of the base, and the phase must stay active
Over-blocking must fail: an all-landed phase with receipts for some tasks and ancestry-only evidence (hand-landed, no receipt, branch may be gone) for another archives in one sweep
Repeated sweeps over a blocked phase stay idempotent -- no unbounded indeterminate-marker flood (cf. test_status_surfaces_recurring_stop_once_without_crashing)
A deleted branch after a clean receipted land still counts landed via the receipt fast path
